rules: A paid sponsor cannot be replaced during its purchased protection period
Quarterfinal and semifinal plans release only after every result in their round is finalized
Whole-tournament coverage includes the final and winner spotlight and follows the next tournament start, including postponements
Whole-tournament coverage remains protected if a successor has not been published yet
Expired cards can be booked for a remaining period at fixed prices, without bidding
Immutable plan and per-card amounts determine the verified Stripe checkout total
Stale, overlapping or late payments cannot displace a protected sponsor and are queued for refund
